t: 无点条约在华盛顿领地签署.
te: Point No Point Treaty is signed in Washington Territory.
dz: 无点条约在华盛顿领地签署.
de: Point No Point Treaty is signed in Washington Territory.

t: 巴拿马运河铁路的一台机车首次从大西洋运行到太平洋.
te: A locomotive on the Panama Canal Railway runs from the Atlantic Ocean to the Pacific Ocean for the first time.
dz: 巴拿马运河铁路的一台机车首次从大西洋运行到太平洋.
de: A locomotive on the Panama Canal Railway runs from the Atlantic Ocean to the Pacific Ocean for the first time.

t: 卡萨·海卢被加冕为特沃德罗斯二世,埃塞俄比亚皇帝.
te: Kassa Hailu is crowned Tewodros II, Emperor of Ethiopia.
dz: 卡萨·海卢被加冕为特沃德罗斯二世,埃塞俄比亚皇帝.
de: Kassa Hailu is crowned Tewodros II, Emperor of Ethiopia.

t: 德克萨斯州通过电报与美国其他地区连接,新奥尔良和德克萨斯州马歇尔的连接完成.
te: Texas is linked by telegraph to the rest of the United States, with the completion of a connection between New Orleans …
dz: 德克萨斯州通过电报与美国其他地区连接,新奥尔良和德克萨斯州马歇尔的连接完成.
de: Texas is linked by telegraph to the rest of the United States, with the completion of a connection between New Orleans and Marshall, Texas.

t: 亚历山大二世出任俄罗斯沙皇.
te: Alexander II becomes Tsar of Russia.
dz: 亚历山大二世出任俄罗斯沙皇.
de: Alexander II becomes Tsar of Russia.

t: "来自密苏里州的"边境鲁夫主义者"入侵堪萨斯州并强行选举亲奴隶制的立法机构.
te: "Border Ruffians" from Missouri invade Kansas and force election of a pro-slavery legislature.
dz: 美国内战的起源:"来自密苏里州的"边境鲁夫主义者"入侵堪萨斯州并强行选举亲奴隶制的立法机构.
de: Origins of the American Civil War: "Border Ruffians" from Missouri invade Kansas and force election of a pro-slavery legislature.

t: 美国冒险家威廉·沃克率领约60人从旧金山出发，前往征服尼加拉瓜。
te: American adventurer William Walker departs from San Francisco with about 60 men to conquer Nicaragua.
dz: 美国冒险家威廉·沃克率领约60人从旧金山出发，前往征服尼加拉瓜。
de: American adventurer William Walker departs from San Francisco with about 60 men to conquer Nicaragua.

t: 美国冒险家威廉·沃克征服了尼加拉瓜.
te: The American adventurer William Walker conquers Nicaragua.
dz: 美国冒险家威廉·沃克征服了尼加拉瓜.
de: The American adventurer William Walker conquers Nicaragua.

t: Henry C. Wayne少校乘USS补给船离开纽约 采购骆驼成立美国骆驼队.
te: Major Henry C. Wayne departs New York aboard the USS Supply to procure camels to establish the U.S. Camel Corps.
dz: Henry C. Wayne少校乘USS补给船离开纽约 采购骆驼成立美国骆驼队.
de: Major Henry C. Wayne departs New York aboard the USS Supply to procure camels to establish the U.S. Camel Corps.

t: 朱塞佩·威尔第的第二十部歌剧《西西里晚祷》在巴黎首演。
te: Twentieth opera of Giuseppe Verdi, Les vêpres siciliennes ("The Sicilian Vespers"), is premiered in Paris.
dz: 朱塞佩·威尔第的第二十部歌剧《西西里晚祷》在巴黎首演。
de: Twentieth opera of Giuseppe Verdi, Les vêpres siciliennes ("The Sicilian Vespers"), is premiered in Paris.

t: 西格玛·齐兄弟会成立于北美.
te: Sigma Chi fraternity is founded in North America.
dz: 西格玛·齐兄弟会成立于北美.
de: Sigma Chi fraternity is founded in North America.

t: 昆厄尔和克勒特将土地割让给美国.
te: The Quinault and the Quileute cede their land to the United States.
dz: 签署"昆厄尔条约":昆厄尔和克勒特将土地割让给美国.
de: Signing of the Quinault Treaty: The Quinault and the Quileute cede their land to the United States.

t: 沃尔特·惠特曼所着"诗集""草地之叶"一书的第一版在布鲁克林出版.
te: The first edition of Walt Whitman's book of poems, Leaves of Grass, is published in Brooklyn.
dz: 沃尔特·惠特曼所着"诗集""草地之叶"一书的第一版在布鲁克林出版.
de: The first edition of Walt Whitman's book of poems, Leaves of Grass, is published in Brooklyn.

t: 蒙特罗萨的第一升座,阿尔卑斯山的第二高峰.
te: The first ascent of Monte Rosa, the second highest summit in the Alps.
dz: 蒙特罗萨的第一升座,阿尔卑斯山的第二高峰.
de: The first ascent of Monte Rosa, the second highest summit in the Alps.

t: 奥兰战争:苏门林纳战役开战.
te: The Battle of Suomenlinna begins.
dz: 奥兰战争:苏门林纳战役开战.
de: Åland War: The Battle of Suomenlinna begins.

t: 在内布拉斯加州,美国将军威廉·S·哈尼手下的700名士兵以攻击一苏村并杀死100名男女老幼来为…
te: In Nebraska, 700 soldiers under United States General William S. Harney avenge the Grattan massacre by attacking a Siou…
dz: 美国印地安战争:在内布拉斯加州,美国将军威廉·S·哈尼手下的700名士兵以攻击一苏村并杀死100名男女老幼来为格拉坦大屠杀复仇.
de: American Indian Wars: In Nebraska, 700 soldiers under United States General William S. Harney avenge the Grattan massacre by attacking a Sioux village and killing 100 men, women and children.

t: 法军出击马拉可夫之塔,导致塞瓦斯托波尔被俘.
te: The French assault the tower of Malakoff, leading to the capture of Sevastopol.
dz: 克里米亚战争:法军出击马拉可夫之塔,导致塞瓦斯托波尔被俘.
de: Crimean War: The French assault the tower of Malakoff, leading to the capture of Sevastopol.

t: 塞瓦斯托波尔的围攻在俄军放弃城市后结束.
te: The Siege of Sevastopol comes to an end when Russian forces abandon the city.
dz: 克里米亚战争:塞瓦斯托波尔的围攻在俄军放弃城市后结束.
de: Crimean War: The Siege of Sevastopol comes to an end when Russian forces abandon the city.

t: 菲律宾伊洛伊洛港由西班牙政府向世界贸易开放.
te: The Philippine port of Iloilo is opened to world trade by the Spanish administration.
dz: 菲律宾伊洛伊洛港由西班牙政府向世界贸易开放.
de: The Philippine port of Iloilo is opened to world trade by the Spanish administration.

t: 日本江户发生强烈地震,由震动和随后的火灾给关东地区造成了相当大的破坏. 它造成7 000至10…
te: A powerful earthquake occurs in Edo, Japan, causing considerable damage in the Kantō region from the shaking and subseq…
dz: 日本江户发生强烈地震,由震动和随后的火灾给关东地区造成了相当大的破坏. 它造成7 000至10 000人死亡,并摧毁了大约14 000所建筑物.
de: A powerful earthquake occurs in Edo, Japan, causing considerable damage in the Kantō region from the shaking and subsequent fires. It had a death toll of 7,000–10,000 people and destroyed around 14,000 buildings.

t: 大卫·利文斯通成为第一个在现在的赞比亚-津巴布韦看到维多利亚瀑布的欧洲人.
te: David Livingstone becomes the first European to see the Victoria Falls in what is now Zambia-Zimbabwe.
dz: 大卫·利文斯通成为第一个在现在的赞比亚-津巴布韦看到维多利亚瀑布的欧洲人.
de: David Livingstone becomes the first European to see the Victoria Falls in what is now Zambia-Zimbabwe.

t: 在英国伯明翰,阿尔伯特,康克王子为伯明翰和米德兰研究所奠基石.
te: In Birmingham, England, Albert, Prince Consort lays the foundation stone of the Birmingham and Midland Institute.
dz: 在英国伯明翰,阿尔伯特,康克王子为伯明翰和米德兰研究所奠基石.
de: In Birmingham, England, Albert, Prince Consort lays the foundation stone of the Birmingham and Midland Institute.
